INSERT INTO t_daily_summary ( stat_date, uv, pv, new_users, total_revenue, order_count, trade_users, recharge_users, recharge_amount, discount_amount ) SELECT #{targetDate} AS stat_date,
-- 1. 统计 UV 和 PV (利用范围查询代替 DATE() 函数，完美走时间索引) (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id, client_ip)) FROM t_user_browse_log WHERE enter_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND enter_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS uv,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_user_browse_log WHERE enter_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND enter_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS pv,
-- 2. 统计新增用户 (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dwd_user_register_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS new_users,
-- 3. 统计交易相关指标 (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM dwd_trade_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND type = 'PAY_SUCCESS') AS total_revenue,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dwd_trade_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND type = 'PAY_SUCCESS') AS order_count,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM dwd_trade_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND type = 'PAY_SUCCESS') AS trade_users,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(discount_amount), 0) FROM dwd_trade_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND type = 'PAY_SUCCESS') AS discount_amount,
-- 4. 统计充值相关指标 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM dwd_recharge_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS recharge_users,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM dwd_recharge_log WHERE event_time >= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND event_time <= CONCAT(#{targetDate}, ' 23:59:59')) AS recharge_amount
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE uv = VALUES(uv), pv = VALUES(pv), new_users = VALUES(new_users), total_revenue = VALUES(total_revenue), order_count = VALUES(order_count), trade_users = VALUES(trade_users), recharge_users = VALUES(recharge_users), recharge_amount = VALUES(recharge_amount), discount_amount = VALUES(discount_amount);
